verdicts.decision_note: The client requests placement of three new kitchen cabinets within the three-unit subdivision plan, establishing the Unit 3 cabinet-layout requirement and its architectural-plan scope.
The client authorizes development of detailed kitchen-cabinet designs beyond the initial concept-level drawing, changing the required design detail for Unit 3 alongside the other units.
The client specifies an open living-room kitchen and 240 cm upper and lower cabinet runs for every unit, directly changing Unit 3's kitchen configuration without making prior attributes obsolete.
The client identifies a preferred alternative counter position specifically for Unit 3 while making adequate separation from the bathroom door a concrete spatial acceptance condition.
